q12: SELECT "l_shipdate", "l_commitdate", "l_receiptdate", "l_shipmode", "l_orderkey" FROM "tpch"."lineitem" WHERE ("l_shipmode" IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')) AND ("l_commitdate" < "l_receiptdate") AND ("l_shipdate" < "l_commitdate") AND ("l_receiptdate" >= DATE '1994-01-01') AND ("l_receiptdate" < DATE '1995-01-01') AND ("l_commitdate" < DATE '1995-01-01') AND ("l_shipdate" < DATE '1995-01-01')
SELECT "o_orderkey", "o_orderpriority" FROM "tpch"."orders" WHERE ("o_orderkey" IS NOT NULL)
q14: SELECT "l_partkey", "l_extendedprice", "l_discount", "l_shipdate" FROM "tpch"."lineitem" WHERE ("l_shipdate" >= DATE '1995-09-01') AND ("l_shipdate" < DATE '1995-10-01')

q19: SELECT "p_partkey", "p_brand", "p_size", "p_container" FROM "tpch"."part" WHERE ("p_brand" IN ('Brand#12', 'Brand#23', 'Brand#34')) AND ("p_size" <= 15) AND ("p_container" IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG', 'MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK', 'LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG')) AND ("p_size" >= 1)
